## Initial release

- Renders Carve fenced blocks and complete `.crv` pages in Zensical.
- Supports extensions, Unicode/Twemoji symbols, custom symbol maps, and
  theme-aware heading, code, task-list, and table-of-contents output.
- Optionally prerenders Graphviz and D2 diagrams through Kroki or a local
  command, with deterministic caching and safe fallback.
- Isolates per-page failures and reports configuration and source diagnostics.

The release gate installs the built wheel and builds a real Zensical site
through both integration seams before PyPI publishing.
